headline: China's Top Three Airlines Head for Full-Year Losses on Fuel Costs
summary: China's top three airlines are heading for full-year losses as rising fuel costs remain a major headwind, prompting efforts to boost flying hours per plane to control expenses.
why: Jet fuel represents a major operating expense for commercial airlines, directly impacting profitability and sector-wide equity valuations.

impacts.name: Chinese Airlines
impacts.why: Higher fuel costs create severe headwinds leading toward full-year losses.
